newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA GETS 100 MLN MARK SIEMENS MEDICAL EQUIPMENT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA GETS 100 MLN MARK SIEMENS MEDICAL EQUIPMENT.

text.p: Bulgaria will receive medical equipment worth 100 million marks from Germany's concern Siemens to modernise its antiquated health care system, a company official said on Wednesday.
"Some 50 million marks will be used to set up joint production of X-ray equipment," Siemens-Bulgaria office expert Ivan Zahariev told Reuters.
The X-ray joint venture is expected to begin production in Bulgaria in mid-1997, said Zahariev.
The remaining 50 million marks will be spent on import of cancer treatment equipment, he added.

Under the deal, ratified by parliament on Wednesday, Bulgaria is expected to repay the 100 million marks credit to Siemens in 10 years after two years of grace. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
